cues.prompt: A large egg hatching. Brittle eggshell cracks sharply, breaks open with a satisfying crunchy pop, and little shell pieces tumble down. Close dry foley, one quick hatching event. No chimes, voices or music.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a clean hard-shell/capsule crack; closest to egg hatching.

cues.prompt: A heavy hammer swung forcefully, with a short dense rush of air and a hard wooden thump. Punchy low-mid weight, immediate attack, one swing. Close dry physical foley.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a clean sharp thud with pronounced low-frequency punch.

cues.prompt: Archery foley: a wooden recurve bow releases one arrow. A tight, wiry bowstring twang followed by the arrow's brief feathered hiss. Close microphone beside the archer. Realistic dry recording of a bow and arrow being fired once.
cues.selection_note: Arrow-release snap from take 7 with a tightly damped generated string pluck; avoids sustained bell-like ringing.

cues.prompt: A hammer hits a solid block of dense hardwood once. A sharp attack over a deep chunky thud with a very short decay. Close, dry, forceful blunt impact foley.
cues.selection_note: Short generated impact crack layered over a much stronger low wooden thud; metallic ringing candidates rejected.

cues.prompt: A real trumpet section plays a loud military charge fanfare: crisp bright brass playing three rising notes, then holding a strong final note. Open trumpets, clean studio recording, confident, sharply articulated and in tune. Brass instruments only.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a bright clear trumpet fanfare, without warbling or distortion.

cues.prompt: A triumphant victory trumpet fanfare. A real brass section plays a bold rising major-key melody ending on a sustained victorious chord. Bright open trumpets in the foreground, celebratory, full volume, clean studio recording, in tune.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a triumphant brass fanfare with a celebratory melody.

cues.prompt: A grand triumphant trumpet fanfare celebrating the final victory. A large real brass ensemble plays a jubilant rising flourish and an emphatic sustained major chord. Bright trumpets over rich trombones, powerful and celebratory. Clean, in-tune orchestral recording.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a brass ensemble fanfare; train-horn candidates rejected.

cues.prompt: Sad trumpets play a short descending minor-key defeat fanfare. A real trumpet and trombone section, mournful but clearly audible, ending on a low sustained minor chord. Rich expressive brass, clean studio recording, in tune. No voices.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a slow mournful brass melodic phrase.

cues.prompt: One massive steel sledgehammer smashing a thick wooden beam. A heavy low thud with an explosive dry crack and a short shower of splinters. Extremely weighty close-up sledgehammer impact foley, one powerful blow.
cues.selection_note: Generated steel-on-hard-surface strike with added low hammer mass, a short crack, and damped metallic overtones.

cues.prompt: Archery foley: a heavy English longbow releases one arrow. A powerful low wiry bowstring TWANG with wooden bow-limb resonance and a brief arrow feather hiss. Close microphone beside the archer, one forceful shot. Realistic bow and arrow release.
cues.selection_note: Lower, longer string twang and fuller wooden body than the regular release; game gain is 3 dB higher.

cues.prompt: A heavy spear thrown once through the air. One smooth clean rushing whoosh with a crisp release and a short natural decay. Close dry foley. No crackling, buzzing, warbling, rattling or metallic ringing.
cues.selection_note: Screened as a clean whoosh/impact without artifacts; distorted candidate rejected.

screening_note: Open-ended automated audio descriptions are used alongside level/tail metrics. They are an imperfect source-identification signal, not human audition.
